Feedback_Text: I searched for wireless earbuds under 3000 and got results that were way over my budget. Had to keep changing filters.
The search suggestions are actually useful. I typed 'running shoes' and it showed the right brands straight away.
Why does the search reset every time I open a product and go back? I lose the filters and have to start again.
I searched for a 1 ton inverter AC but most results were for non-inverter models. Search needs to understand the full product requirement.
Could you add a compare option right from the search results? Opening five tabs to compare laptops is annoying.
The category filters are confusing. I selected 'home appliances' and the list included phone accessories somehow.
Found what I needed quickly today. The brand and price filters worked perfectly.
Search says no results for a product that I can find by browsing the category. Is the search not indexing everything?
The Nova X5 page says 128 GB in one place and 256 GB in the specifications. Which storage version am I actually buying?
I ordered the StrideFlex running shoes in my usual size and they feel too tight. The product page really needs a proper size chart.
The HomePro mixer grinder works really well for chutneys and smoothies. The jars are sturdy and the motor feels powerful. Happy with this purchase.
Some Nova X5 reviews seem to be for a different phone model. Ratings are mixed together and it's hard to trust them.
For the HomePro mixer grinder, please show verified-purchase badges and let us sort reviews by most recent. That would make comparisons easier.
The TechBook Air laptop warranty details are buried at the bottom. I almost placed the order without noticing it only had a 6 month warranty.
GlowCare Daily Moisturizer is lightweight and absorbs quickly without feeling sticky. Would love to see a larger pack size.
Payment failed twice but my bank sent two debit messages. I don't know if the order went through and support hasn't replied.
Checkout keeps asking me to enter my address again even though it's saved in my account. Very frustrating.
UPI payment was quick and the order confirmation came immediately. Smooth experience.
The delivery fee appeared only on the last screen. Please show the full amount before I start checkout.
My card gets declined here but works on other sites. Tried three times. Please check the payment gateway.
I wish there was a one-click reorder for things I buy every month. Checkout has too many steps for repeat orders.
Promo code says applied but the total doesn't change. This happened with two different codes.
Guest checkout would be nice. I don't want to create an account just to buy one item.
The app said out for delivery all day, then at night it changed to delayed. No explanation or updated date.
Package arrived two days earlier than expected and was packed well. Great job.
Tracking hasn't moved from 'shipped' for four days. Is the parcel lost?
Delivery person marked it delivered but nobody came to my door. I had to call support and wait for them to investigate.
Can we choose a delivery time slot? I miss deliveries because I'm at work during the day.
The package was left outside the apartment gate in the rain. The box was wet when I found it.
Delivery estimate kept changing from Monday to Wednesday to Friday. Please give a date customers can rely on.
I like that the tracking map shows where the driver is. It helped me plan when to be home.
Ordered two items together but they came in separate deliveries without telling me. I was worried one item was missing.
Return pickup was scheduled for yesterday and nobody showed up. Now the app says I need to reschedule.
Refund still hasn't reached my account after 10 days. The status has not changed either.
The return process was easy and the refund came the next day. Much better than I expected.
Why do I have to print a return label? I don't have a printer. A QR code for pickup would be easier.
The item was damaged on arrival but the return request was rejected saying it was outside the return window. I reported it the same day!
I returned only one item from a multi-item order but the app shows the whole order as returned. Please make item-level return status clearer.
I can't find the reason for my refund amount being lower than what I paid. The deductions aren't explained.
Please let customers exchange a size directly instead of returning it and placing a new order.
The chatbot kept giving me the same article and there was no obvious way to speak to a person. Waste of time.
The support agent understood the issue and sorted out my missing item in one chat. Thank you.
I had to explain the same problem to three different agents. Can't they see the previous conversation?
Waited nearly 25 minutes on the phone and then the call dropped. Please offer a callback option.
Support promised an update by email but I never received one. I had to contact them again.
Since the latest update the app freezes when I tap my cart. I have to close and reopen it.
Text is tiny on the order details screen. Please add a way to increase font size.
App is easy to use and loads much faster now. Shopping feels smoother.
The same product showed one price on the listing and a higher price after I opened it. Which price is correct?
Please make offer conditions clearer. It said 20% off but at checkout I found out it only applied if I bought three items.
